import json, re, sys

def run_solution(fen):
    for pattern, repl in json.load(open("/app/re.json")):
        fen = re.sub(pattern, repl, fen)
    fens = [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in fen.split("\n")]
    return fens

def reference(fen):
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    out = []
    for move in board.legal_moves:
        if move.promotion and move.promotion != chess.QUEEN:
            continue
        b = board.copy()
        b.push(move)
        out.append(" ".join(b.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return out

if __name__ == "__main__":
    fen = sys.argv[1]
    ours = run_solution(fen)
    ref = reference(fen)
    print("ours  : %d moves" % len(ours))
    print("ref   : %d moves" % len(ref))
    so, sr = set(ours), set(ref)
    missing = sr - so
    extra = so - sr
    dup = len(ours) - len(so)
    ok = (so == sr) and dup == 0 and len(ours) == len(ref)
    print("MATCH" if ok else "MISMATCH")
    for m in sorted(missing): print("  MISSING:", m)
    for m in sorted(extra): print("  EXTRA  :", m)
    if dup: print("  DUPES:", dup)
